answer.reason: The verses state several deeds of Mary of Bethany beyond what the summary already gives: sitting at Jesus' feet, falling at his feet in grief for Lazarus, and anointing his feet.

clauses.english: sat at Jesus' feet and heard his word, and was said to have chosen the good part
clauses.quote: which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

clauses.english: fell at Jesus' feet in grief when her brother Lazarus had died
clauses.quote: she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

clauses.english: anointed the feet of Jesus with costly ointment and wiped them with her hair
clauses.quote: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus

doubts: JHN 11:2 and JHN 11:45 are context for the same deeds and add nothing separate, so they are not cited as clauses.
The first clause joins sitting at his feet with the commendation of her choice; it is kept as one scene in Luke 10.
